lines: A weapon is honest about harm. People should try being that honest before causing it.
Good. Now keep your temper sheathed unless the village needs it drawn.
Harm is easy to make and hard to take back. At least you know which you did.
Fine. Keep the sharp parts of yourself pointed where they belong.
An apology is not a sheath, but it may keep the edge from cutting twice.
I respect honest remorse more than polished excuses.
If you cannot control your hand, no apology will be enough. Control it.
Good. Let this be the last time I hear that tone for this reason.
